integrity: Proof supplies arbitrary-size exact identities; finite tests are supplementary and not a proof. General gain-graph representation and Heilmann–Lieb real-rootedness are credited as prior results.
limitations: Only positive alternating pendant dimer weights and unit cycle edges on even sunlets; matching-root coordinate x, not physical activity z. No thermodynamic phase-transition claim. Historical-priority comparison is incomplete for an inaccessible directly related article.
title: Exact finite-size dimerization gap for alternating sunlet monomer–dimer zeros
